items.name: larson-scanner
items.title: Knight Rider — Larson Scanner
items.description: A programmable sci-fi light scanner with six patterns, custom paths, color, voice, complete reduced-motion behavior, and touch-safe programming.
items.author: Scott E. Telling
items.docs: Import LarsonScanner from your components/ui folder. Sound starts muted. The canvas freezes every time-based effect for reduced motion and pauses when the element is offscreen. The purpose-built light belongs inside the scanner frame; do not spread its glow into surrounding product chrome.

items.name: beautiful-ui-foundation
items.title: Beautiful UI Elements Foundation
items.description: The shared responsive, accessible foundation for Kit's adapted Beautiful UI elements.
items.author: Shane Levine; adapted by Scott E. Telling
items.docs: Adapted from Beautiful UI by Shane Levine under the MIT License. Keep the included license notice. The foundation uses solid surfaces, 44-pixel controls, responsive layouts, visible focus, and reduced-motion behavior.
